newsitem.title: USA: Digital Systems cut to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: Digital Systems cut to hold from buy.

text.p: Oppenheimer & Co downgraded Digital Systems International Inc to market performer or hold from buy, analyst Mitchel Sonies said.
"There's an uncertain outlook with the acquisition," Sonies told Reuters, referring to the company's planned purchase of ViewStar Corp VSTA.O.
"They're going into a new business and there are risks associated with it," he said.
Digital Systems was off three at 12 on Nasdaq volume of 2.1 million shares.
Sonies, speaking after the company made a presentation here to an American Electronics Association conference, said he was still optimistic about the company's long-term prospects.
Digital Systems, based in Redmond, Wash., makes telecommunications software.
